summary_en: This study compares telisotuzumab adizutecan, given alone, with standard of care in adults with colorectal cancer that is circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) positive after adjuvant treatment and has no radiographic evidence of disease. Telisotuzumab adizutecan is given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and the number and timing of doses are not stated; standard of care is chosen by the investigator and is described as active surveillance. The study runs for approximately 51 months, and its purpose is to assess change in disease activity; it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara telisotuzumab adizutecan, administrado solo, con el tratamiento estándar en adultos con cáncer colorrectal que tiene ADN tumoral circulante (ctDNA) positivo después del tratamiento adyuvante y no presenta evidencia radiográfica de enfermedad. El telisotuzumab adizutecan se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV), y el número y la frecuencia de las dosis no se indican; el tratamiento estándar lo elige el investigador y se describe como vigilancia activa. El estudio dura aproximadamente 51 meses y su propósito es evaluar el cambio en la actividad de la enfermedad; es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum.
At least 3 months of platinum-based doublet chemotherapy, given before or after surgery.
No radiographic evidence of disease on chest, abdominal and pelvic CT within 6 weeks before first dose.
ctDNA positive within 1 year after adjuvant therapy or tumor resection, with treatment starting within 6 weeks of positivity.
not_for: No available surgical tumor tissue sample.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed systemic steroids.
Active interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis on screening chest CT.
Topoisomerase inhibitors used as part of adjuvant therapy.
